deletion_trials.reason: Removing the replacement leaves the failed assertion sqrt(a^2)=a, which is false for negative a and does not establish the theorem.

reason: For every real a, |a| is nonnegative and |a|^2=a^2. Thus |a| satisfies the defining properties of the arithmetic square root of a^2, so sqrt(a^2)=|a|. The replacement fixes the false cancellation of square root and squaring without changing the theorem, assumption, domain, target, or any unrelated branch.
